snippet.title: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor (New Expansion) - Announcement Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
An announcement trailer for Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor's new expansion. Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor builds on it's monstrously successfull auto battling formula. Reverse Bullet Hell...With Mining!
